description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_FindAJob"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies" processRef="Process_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" messageRef="Message_Application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase completed" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmploymentPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmploymentNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Job applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_JobSearch" name="Start job search"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive application receipt confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewChoice" name="Negotiate a job interview?" default="Flow_InterviewNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" name="Notify company that probation is complete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" name="Continue with review visibility and employment outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" name="Receive employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?" default="Flow_JobNotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Did you rate the company C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentJob" name="Permanent job; process ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCLess" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_PermanentJob"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application and employment workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate job application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?" default="Flow_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoOffer" name="Company does not want the applicant to work for it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation phase completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate job applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" name="Notify applicant that the job becomes permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome" name="Notify applicant that the job does not become permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentOutcomeSent" name="Permanent employment outcome sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotPermanentOutcomeSent" name="Non-permanent employment outcome sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferWanted" name="Company wants the applicant to work for it" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOffer" name="Company does not want the applicant" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_PermanentOutcomeSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_NotPermanentOutcomeSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
